tasks.short: Set project targets and report progress

steps.what: Develop proposed project objectives and targets with measurement definitions
Verify current project progress records against agreed measurement definitions
Copy verified target and progress fields into the management report
Explain progress, qualify deviations and approve the report to management

tasks.design: Configure {PROJECT} and {DOCS} reporting to reuse verified target and progress fields. The engineer retains objective setting, source validation and explanation to management.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status reporting can repeat copying without resolving what a target means.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can reuse explicit definitions and current field values.
tasks.still_hard: A milestone marked complete may not establish environmental improvement.
tasks.human_edge: Set meaningful targets and explain deviations without confusing activity with outcomes.
tasks.altitude: Less report copying may leave more time for target quality; budget and project approval rights are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Relatics provides requirements and verification management, which is adjacent to traceable objectives; it does not establish automatic project outcome judgement or this time estimate.
Template field reuse and savings here are an unmeasured model-knowledge design.

assumptions: Boundary covers target development and later management reporting, not project execution or separate monitoring1370. Shared progress validation has one owner in roll-ups.

Engineer produces objective IDs, baselines, units, target values/dates, formulas and source definitions in s1's35 hours. Existing management approval occurs after proposal and before related project execution; project owners then produce dated activity/outcome records as execution proceeds, before s2. Engineer captures verified report period, current values, source versions and caveats in s2's25 hours before s3. Missing records use manual clarification and explicit unknowns, not an inferred progress flag.
Test native report configuration before custom code. Already automatic status exports earn no additional saving.

Seven focal upkeep hours per100 baseline cover field/version checks and exceptions; three other-role hours cover configuration support. Existing project-owner records and management review remain outside and unchanged.
research_questions: Can native status reuse save time after meaningful outcome and source checks?

steps.what: Verify monitoring observations and program measurement definitions
Compare environmental program values with specified baselines and targets
Monitor actual progress and investigate the meaning of deviations

tasks.design: Configure {BI} comparisons from verified program observations in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The engineer retains source checks, contextual interpretation and investigation of deviations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated comparison tables may be manual while measurement validity remains unresolved.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dashboards can repeat explicit formulas and expose missing intervals.
tasks.still_hard: Seasonality, operating volume and measurement changes can mimic improvement.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether observed change is meaningful and what needs investigation.

ambition.what: Review coverage-qualified program deviations between scheduled reports

tasks.altitude: Less comparison preparation may leave more time for investigation; intervention authority is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Configured program comparisons can reduce repeated table preparation; this is an unmeasured model-knowledge design, not proof of environmental improvement.

assumptions: Boundary is program monitoring, not new sampling work, project execution or management report layout1373. Shared observations are counted once in roll-ups.

Test native dashboards and queries before custom integration. Existing automatic comparisons create no new labour saving.

research_questions: Do comparison gains remain after unit, coverage and operating-context checks?

tasks.short: Prepare environmental investigation and recommendation reports

steps.what: Verify environmental investigation sources and define report recommendations and scope
Prepare or update the environmental report draft from verified sources

loop.purpose: Draft report wording and source-linked changes without making new technical recommendations
loop.input: Verified findings, calculation records, explicit recommendation brief and prior report version
loop.output: Report draft with change marks and source references
loop.check: Engineer checks technical meaning, units, numerical provenance, recommendation strength, caveats and omitted contrary findings against originals
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; conflicting sources or unsupported claims use manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates fill fixed fields, but technical explanation and revision wording need contextual prose

steps.what: Review technical conclusions and approve the complete environmental report

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} templates first, then a bounded draft for report prose and marked revisions. The engineer verifies meaning and sources and approves the final technical report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Report wording and updates can repeat material while still needing technical scrutiny.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked drafting can propose prose without delegating technical conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent report can overstate causation or the certainty of a recommendation.
tasks.human_edge: Judge what the investigation supports and keep limitations visible.
tasks.altitude: Some wording time may shrink; engineering conclusions and approval remain human.

evidence.claim: A writing experiment with453 professionals reported faster writing, but participants were not engineers and it does not establish environmental report savings.
The bounded engineering report design and local saving are unmeasured model-knowledge assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is report preparation/review, not investigation, sampling or calculations. Existing technical evidence is produced in separately counted work before s1.

Engineer captures report purpose, source IDs/versions, verified values/units, explicit recommendations, uncertainties, template and revision scope in s1's retained30 hours. Missing evidence or unclear recommendations return to manual clarification; no free compliant-report or technically-correct flag is assumed.
Test native templates and revision comparison before custom drafting. Existing automatic layout earns no new saving.
Seven focal upkeep hours per100 baseline cover source/template drift and output sampling; three other-role support hours cover restricted workspace setup.
research_questions: Does full technical assertion checking leave any net wording saving?

already_counted.description: Brief/source capture, draft meaning verification and technical approval

approvals.approved_version: Complete report text, numerical tables, source versions, recommendations and attachments; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R84.25 gross15.75 minus7 upkeep net8.75. Range0-4 allows contested sources or heavy technical rewriting at0; clear repeat report updates support a small gain.

tasks.short: Maintain quality assurance procedures and documentation

steps.what: Define quality assurance changes and verify their source requirements
Prepare or revise quality assurance documentation and procedures

loop.purpose: Draft controlled wording changes from an explicit approved process brief
loop.input: Source requirements, current document version and specified process changes
loop.output: Marked procedure draft and requirement references
loop.check: Engineer checks that every instruction preserves intended control, responsibilities, sequence, limits and exceptions and identifies omitted requirements
loop.stop: One change draft and one correction; uncertain control meaning uses manual revision
loop.why_not_simpler: Native change control handles versions; the meaning of revised instructions requires contextual writing

steps.what: Verify procedural adequacy and approve the controlled quality documentation version

tasks.design: Use native controlled-document features in {DOCS} before adding bounded revision drafting. The engineer checks control meaning and approves the complete version within existing delegated responsibilities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated wording changes can consume time while control adequacy still needs expert review.
tasks.enabler_now: Marked source-linked revisions can support writing without deciding whether the underlying control is sufficient.
tasks.still_hard: An apparently minor wording change can alter responsibility or an important exception.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether the procedure can be followed and actually protects the intended quality outcome.
tasks.altitude: Some revision wording may shorten; quality accountability and formal release rights are unchanged.

reach.task: Check that controls have testable acceptance criteria

evidence.claim: Kneat Gx supports validation protocols and records; this is adjacent controlled-document capability, not a demonstrated environmental procedure-writing saving.
Bounded procedure drafting and local time savings are unmeasured model-knowledge assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is engineering preparation and internal approval of quality documents, not redesigning the physical process, staff training or formal quality-manager release. Existing release checks stay outside and unchanged.

Engineer captures current version, requirement/source IDs and versions, intended process changes, roles, sequence, limits, exceptions and revision scope in s1's retained35 hours. Process owners supply existing verified change information before this capture. Missing control meaning returns to manual clarification before drafting; no free compliant-procedure flag is assumed.
Test native templates, version control and redlines before custom code. Existing document runtime creates no saving.
Six focal upkeep hours per100 baseline cover prompt/template and missed-requirement checks; three other-role support hours cover document configuration.
research_questions: Can marked drafts preserve every control meaning after independent requirement review?
